title: Promise ledger (gf-promises/1)
description: What a game promises a player, from the locked spec and the requirements ledger (builder/loop/promises.mjs promisesOf), and how each one was settled (settlePromises). row.<id>: a ledger row a registry part does, in the creator's words. build.<n>: spec.build item n, core, proven only by the play-tester seeing it work. control.<action>: a control does what it says. loop.closes: the loop's own promise. The kit's own standing promises (kit.*) and the creator's accept items (accept.<n>) may be added. Delivery carries every promise as proven, failed, untested or unreachable, each named; the list is never shorter than at the lock.

hud.description: The controls line the play-tester is given.

text.description: Plain words a player would say (a row's says the creator's words).

core.description: Part of the first-minute loop: still failing after the repair rounds, the job fails.

confirm.description: Only the play-tester seeing it work proves it (every build promise).

friends.description: About friends (the ledger's players line, or a build line that serves it): proven by the play-tester only with two player-driven seats, checked against the run's own record (builder/loop/playtest.mjs twoSeats); seen with bots or alone it stays untested.

proofs.description: What may prove it: a gate (gate:C), or a measure of it (gate:C/13), a test of the game's own (test:<file>), or the play-tester's own screen (play).

look.description: build: the kind this item proves on the runtime.

keys.description: control: the plain words of the control.

area.description: Where a failure of it is repaired (the ladder's specialist rounds).

heldFromLock.description: The game stopped making it; it was put back as worded at the lock.

status.description: proven: every proof that ran agrees (and a confirm promise was seen). failed: a gate it rests on failed, or the tester did not see it. untested: nothing that ran answers it (a gate this runtime skipped, a play-test that did not ask). unreachable: the tester could not get the game to where it would show; counted with failed for the outcome, named apart in the delivery.

seats.description: A friends promise proven: the seats it was seen with.

ref.description: The verdict.json or play-test report it read.
